canonical_project: Ha Nam Smart Operations Center (IOC) with provincial data platform
owner: Ha Nam Provincial People's Committee with VNPT
notes: Province-wide smart operations center launched 27 March 2020 integrating departmental systems and big-data analytics for e-government (Ha Nam was a national e-government pilot 2019-2020); operates on provincial data-center infrastructure. No standalone commercial colocation data center identified in Ha Nam.
